observations: Actual Inter 12 DIP, Vulkan UI backend and native Vulkan Scene recorded by the application.
Semantic actions execute real text-widget handlers, native transactions, floating OS windows and reset; no physical input injection.
Malformed raw field text survives floating/reset; stale edits and dirty close are guarded.
Repairing an unresolved asset reference resumes drawing without viewport reattachment.
Changed capture destinations fail only the capture job and preserve ordinary presentation.
An early fixed-two-pump reset assertion failed; pinned Dock defers content at Background priority. Final script waits up to three seconds for actual field readiness.
Linux 24/24 and 28/28 regression logs are retained from the earlier native integration; final changes after those runs affect Windows bridge/frontend/package paths.
limitations: This is not visual acceptance by the user, Unity feature/pixel parity, or a production performance benchmark.
Physical keyboard/mouse, IME, accessibility and multi-monitor/DPI edge cases remain unqualified.
GUI camera navigation, transform gizmos, automatic Play and persisted layouts remain unfinished.
Resource samples describe this small fixture and do not qualify shipped-game memory or frame time.
Clean-machine distribution and a complete source-level dependency license audit remain pending.
